verdict.rationale: Trivy documents license scanning of container images/filesystems with an opinionated risk classification (trivy-docs-5), which supports detecting dependency licenses, but the evidence pack contains no mention of a dedicated policy-enforcement mechanism (e.g., failing builds on disallowed license categories) beyond the risk labeling itself. missing for 10: explicit documentation of license policy configuration/enforcement (allow/deny lists, exit-code gating on license severity), independent confirmation of license-policy use in CI.
